CustomField.description:
LEAVE-43. The person an Overtime Request is for, which is not the person who raises it - overtime is entered by a manager on the employee's behalf.
OvertimeRequestGuard copies this into OwnerId when the request is APPROVED, not when it is saved. OwnerId is what every reader downstream keys on - OvertimeSummaryService, the OT tab in TimesheetController.getApplicationItems, the Man_hour__c booking and Owner_Name__c - and the first two look only at approved records, so the delay costs nothing. Transferring at save left the manager unable to edit the record they had just created, ApplicationItem__c being Public Read Only.
Required for Overtime Requests by Overtime_Employee_Required rather than at field level: a required User lookup demands a delete constraint Salesforce forbids.
